description: Reads every clip: 1-based position, narration, footage and health. Use before editing or to diagnose problems. clips_in_trouble lists broken clips; health, trouble and fix_by explain each. Follow the server's fix_by: swap_footage = inspect with huasheng_list_footage_candidates then apply with huasheng_replace_clip_footage; edit_text = reword; delete_clip = remove. Name affected clips and their fixes. Pass the 1-based number to huasheng_edit_clip. Never opens a card: explicit timeline viewing uses huasheng_preview_project; project state, decisions and price use huasheng_get_project. Changes nothing.

detail.description: full (default) adds length, footage and opaque media references for the visual timeline; concise gives only positions and narration

pid.description: Video id (15 digits); default: this machine's current video.

name: huasheng_list_clips

animations.description: full only: the motion-graphics overlays. They can be shown or hidden, **but not regenerated or replaced** — Huasheng does not offer that for videos made this way

animation.description: Its id — pass this to show or hide it

cover_media_ids.description: Per-clip thumbnail references for a full-frame MG span

mode.description: overlay keeps the clip footage visible underneath; full_frame is an opaque MG scene

overlay_media_id.description: Opaque media reference for the animation video; overlay mode preserves its alpha channel

as_of.description: When this snapshot was taken, ISO 8601. The card shows it in its header

auto_dub.description: full only: whether rewording a clip also re-records the voice. **When false, editing the words leaves the old audio in place** and picture and sound stop matching — say so rather than letting it happen quietly

auto_footage.description: full only: whether rewording a clip also looks for new footage

can_restore_voice.description: full only: whether the previous recording can still be restored

clip.description: Position, counting from 1 — pass this to edit it

cover_media_id.description: full only: opaque thumbnail reference for an MCP App component

cropped.description: full only: Huasheng crops this clip's footage

fix_by.description: How this one can be fixed, straight from Huasheng — not a guess. swap_footage: call huasheng_list_footage_candidates on this clip. edit_text: reword the narration with huasheng_edit_clip. delete_clip: nothing can save it; remove it with huasheng_edit_clip

footage_s.description: full only: how long the footage itself runs

health.description: Only present when this clip is not fine. working = still being produced, failed = it stopped. A clip with no health field is fine

playback_rate.description: full only: the footage plays at this rate so it matches the narration. Below 1 is slow motion, above 1 means the extra footage is trimmed. **Short footage is not a fault** — Huasheng slows it to fit automatically. Only mention it if it is very slow (below about 0.6) and the user cares about the look

preview_media_id.description: full only: opaque assembled-preview reference for an MCP App component

preview_url_resolved.description: full only, present when the clip is cropped or the video's pace was changed: whether preview_url was confirmed as the latest render. false means it is the older render (uncropped or at the old pace) because the fresh one could not be fetched in time

pronunciations.description: full only, present when set: how specific words are read (set via huasheng_edit_clip)

revision.description: full only: pass back as expected_revision when editing this clip

trouble.description: What went wrong, in Huasheng's own words. Quote it to the user

video_media_id.description: full only: opaque raw-footage reference for an MCP App component

voice_processing.description: full only: whether this clip is currently being re-recorded

clips_in_trouble.description: Clip numbers that failed. Absent when nothing failed. Each one carries trouble and fix_by — say which clips are broken and what fixes them, do not just report a count

items.description: The things being looked at, in order, for the card that renders them

shape.description: Which layout the card should use

total_duration_s.description: full only: how long the whole video runs

truncated.description: Narration was shortened; see how_to_get_full for the whole text

url.description: Link to the video in Huasheng

title: List the clips
